snippet.title: Aniimo | Launch Date Announcement
snippet.description:
🐾 It's official — the gates of Idyll will permanently open for all Pathfinders! 

Aniimo will launch on September 16th for PC and Consoles, and on September 23rd for mobile.

Don't forget to pre-register on your favorite platform and join us in a magical adventure 👉 https://aniimo.link/70NYA5

#Aniimo #AniimoGlobalLaunch #Gamescom2026

Follow us on social media!
X:  https://x.com/Aniimo_EN 
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@aniimo_na   
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aniimo_en/  
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/AniimoGL/  
And join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/aniimo  

Wishlist Aniimo here:
STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4126040/Aniimo/
EPIC Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/aniimo-759396
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/44ki44ol44oi/9PK8PHLCQDF6
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018491
GooglePlay: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.x.aniimos
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/aniimo/id6759098797
